title: Zeroed last endpoint refuses minimal eighth shift
situation: A pinned finite unilateral recurrence certificate has a zero tail from depth 14 and claims that its eighth shift is minimal. All entries at its last nonzero depth are replaced by a checked zero entry while the claimed minimality is retained.
attempted_conclusion: Keep the minimal eighth-shift claim after the depth-13 endpoint is zeroed.

expected.reason: The zeroed endpoint makes the seventh shift annihilate; the retained certificate also fails historical jump replay.
